courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 河岸取水口防淤設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」與「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；河岸取水口防淤設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Network topology and balance residuals" and "Held-out validation and residual metrics" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sediment-resistant river intake design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦守恆、時間同步、狀態估計與可重現決策；河岸取水口防淤設計則以以泥砂收支與局部水理協調河岸取水防淤為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on conservation, time alignment, state estimation and reproducible decisions; Sediment-resistant river intake design centres on coordinating river-intake sediment budgets with local hydraulics, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」與「引水比例與季節工況」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到河岸取水口防淤設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「篩網方向與掃流機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Network topology and balance residuals” and “Diversion fraction and seasonal states”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sediment-resistant river intake design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Screen orientation and sweeping flow mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 雨水貯留與非飲用供水
related.transfer: 可遷移「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」與「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；雨水貯留與非飲用供水的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Network topology and balance residuals" and "Held-out validation and residual metrics" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦守恆、時間同步、狀態估計與可重現決策；雨水貯留與非飲用供水則以集水水量、儲槽時序、可靠度與用途隔離為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on conservation, time alignment, state estimation and reproducible decisions; Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply centres on catchment yield, storage timing, reliability and separated uses, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」與「屋頂集水與逕流體積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雨水貯留與非飲用供水，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Network topology and balance residuals” and “Roof catchment and runoff volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Screen losses and inlet conveyance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 水利設施數位孿生
history.text: 樟宜水再生廠的數位孿生合作在官方紀錄中始於2019年，並在2022年獲得國際水協會創新獎。配水系統的EPANET與製造領域的數位孿生可信度研究，提供不同模型範圍的比較入口。本課不把一套管網工具當作整座處理廠的完整替代，也不宣稱另一座獲獎海淡廠採用相同平台。學習重點是明確定義模型用途、資料交換與驗證證據，將真實工程背景和獨立的教學假設區分。
history.textEn: PUB records the Changi digital-twin collaboration from 2019 and an international innovation award in 2022. Distribution-network modeling and manufacturing credibility research provide comparisons across different model scopes. This course does not equate a pipe-network tool with a complete treatment-plant simulator or claim that another award-winning desalination plant uses the same platform. The learning goal is to define purpose, information exchange and validation evidence while separating documented history from independently assumed teaching models.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」到「情境比較與可追溯決策」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Network topology and balance residuals" through "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
